answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The mirror holds work receipts rather than names, so the atlas of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the cipher of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
